name: Soulsight raises party crit chance and procs Soul Fragment on direct damage
contract: Soulsight 300565 promises 3% party/raid crit and a 15% chance for direct damage to generate a Soul Fragment (805077). EFFECT_0 is native SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AREA_AURA_RAID with SPELL_AURA_MOD_CRIT_PCT (290), EffectBasePoints 2 + DieSides 1 = 3. EFFECT_1 is SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AURA with SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL (42) triggering 805077 at ProcChance 15; the DBC record carries ProcFlags 0, but rev_20260921_20_reaper_talent_procs_two.sql (already on main) inserts a spell_proc row (SpellId 300565, ProcFlags 69652 = done melee auto attack + done spell melee/none-negative dmg class) and binds spell_script_names 300565 -> spell_ascension_reaper_talent_proc, whose AscensionReaperTalentProcs::Rules entry for 300565 is {{0}} (no spell filter, any qualifying direct damage). #3895's zero-hits static grep predates this fix; ALREADY_FIXED_ON_MAIN.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
The buff grants 3% critical strike chance
Let repeated melee swings roll the 15% proc chance (~60 swings, false-failure well under 1%)
Direct damage generated at least one Soul Fragment
